propositions: A shrink-only complexity baseline wrapper must track per-function C901 scores using AST-qualified symbol keys and reject new or increased debt while allowing stale debt removal.
The baseline accepts Ruff return codes 0 and 1 as normal diagnostic-bearing operation (distinguished from scanner failure at code 2+) and validates JSON before counter computation.
Symbol identity must handle nested functions with duplicate leaf names under different parents, async methods, overloads, lambdas, and reject duplicate qualified keys.

The --update-stale maintenance mode uses atomic_write to lower or remove stale ceilings, refuses to write on new/increased debt or schema errors, and leaves the target unchanged on write/replace failure.
The gate exits 0 only when all current findings are at or below recorded ceilings and no scanner/schema error exists, with mutually exclusive active/new/increased/stale counters.
